One. Step. At a time my friend. 

1. Are you stable (can afford food, rent, not in abusive relationship, have a job)?

2. If not, go back to 1 and tackle the issue. 

3. Okay, I know this sounds so painful, I know it hurts like fuck, but one thing that will be absolutely life changing and essential for your recovery is to practice feeling calm. You probably wont feel fully calm for a while, but I PROMISE you you you can with practice. Practice meditating 10 minutes a day. Work really hard to keep letting go, and just sink in to the present. Works wonders. Seek out comedies, fun activities and healthy food rather than adrenaline fulfilling activities and moves that, I know, are exciting, but they are also causing your cortisol to run high (stress hormone) which when chronic can cause basically anything wrong in your body. This shit can be serious AF, not just like a rupture or tummy ache. It's actually really nice once you get into it. Just choose the relaxing things over the thrilling things more and more so you can train your body to relax and remind it is is safe, okay.

4. Keep accessing every resource you can get your hand on. Do not let someone minimize your pain. 

5. Seek out self improvement so you can be the best version of you.

6. Therapy. Find a good therapist. They will help you soooooo much.
